model.works: Publication metadata. A work can be a citing work, a cited work on the Scholar profile, or both.
model.citations: One verified link for an ordered pair of works, classified as Google Scholar or supplemental ResearchGate. IDs are based on the persisted work IDs.
model.observations: What each source reported about a link, including accepted, excluded, ignored, and unverified reports. A related citation ID records the kept link for a duplicate or an ignored report.
model.source_counts: Reported Scholar totals are preserved on profile entries. Curated source counts and unique citation counts are derived from accepted observations and links.
model.reconciliation: Reuse a work ID after confirming identity with identifiers or bibliographic evidence. Reuse a citation ID only for the same citing and cited pair. When an accepted Scholar result matches a supplemental link, change the link source to Google Scholar and preserve its earlier evidence as history. Ignore ResearchGate reports for links already counted on Scholar. Preserve source titles, result IDs and review decisions.
